title: Site-Usage Credit on the Small Business Electricity Supply Site Transfer Fee
content:
Larger sites moving with Beacon Ridge pay less to move. On the site transfer fee of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the kWh of the agreement's energy lines posted in the 12 months before the handling date are added up; 40000 kWh or more take 8.00 dollars off the site transfer fee; at least 20000 but under 40000 kWh take 4.00 dollars off; under 20000 kWh take nothing off.

Only the agreement's own energy charge lines count; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

**Hypothetical sites**

- A restaurant whose energy lines in the window total 52300 kWh: 8.00 USD off.
- A dental office at exactly 40000 kWh: 8.00 USD off; at 39999 kWh it would be 4.00 USD off.
- A boutique at 20000 kWh: 4.00 USD off; at 19999 kWh, nothing off.
- A kiosk at 7400 kWh: nothing off.
